g.text: Mate OpenAI Responses Invocation and Cancellation
clone payload and patch model only
inject endpoint and credential at HTTP layer
same input, tools, reasoning, and options
No automatic create POST replay after an unknown outcome.
No Responses-to-Chat or vendor protocol conversion in Mate.
Every routed upstream must support OpenAI Responses natively.
Cancellation emits no synthetic Responses terminal event.
